name: Zimri
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Elah son of Baasha reigns two years, and his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspires against him while he is drunk in a steward's house and kills him.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Zimri, on taking the throne, slays all the house of Baasha, leaving not one male, according to the word spoken by Jehu against Baasha.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Zimri reigns only seven days in Tirzah. When the people encamped against Gibbethon hear he has slain the king, they make Omri, captain of the host, king over Israel.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Omri and Israel go up and besiege Tirzah, and when Zimri sees the city taken, he burns the king's house over himself and dies.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship
